goal_dimensions.name: 进程所有权与持久化
goal_dimensions.why_it_matters: 选择 Main-owned PTY、独立 Daemon 或 tmux 会决定 App 重启和断连后的 Session 真相
goal_dimensions.current_state: 真实 tmux 在 Local/SSH Host 持有 PTY/Process
goal_dimensions.risk_if_ignored: 如果不确认持久化强度，embeddable 会在实现中隐式退化
goal_dimensions.next_probe: 确认 App 退出与 SSH 断线后继续运行是否是硬不变量

goal_dimensions.name: Local/SSH 一致性
goal_dimensions.why_it_matters: Refproj-like embedded Local 很简单，但 SSH 持久 PTY 需要远端 Session Owner
goal_dimensions.current_state: ExecutionHost + tmux 为 Local/SSH 提供同构命令语义
goal_dimensions.risk_if_ignored: 永久 Hybrid 会带来双恢复模型和双测试面
goal_dimensions.next_probe: 确认是否接受安装和升级远端轻量 AgentMux Daemon

goal_dimensions.name: 流式交互与终端保真
goal_dimensions.why_it_matters: 连续字节流、Backpressure、Resize 与低延迟输入是替换 tmux 的主要用户价值
goal_dimensions.current_state: tmux capture/paste 已正确但零间隔 44-key burst 到 Snapshot 约 4246ms
goal_dimensions.risk_if_ignored: 只包一层接口不会改善流式体验
goal_dimensions.next_probe: 确定是否愿意为这一收益承担 Daemon/Checkpoint 复杂度

goal_dimensions.name: 迁移边界
goal_dimensions.why_it_matters: 用户明确拒绝兼容层、migration 和临时 fallback
goal_dimensions.current_state: 当前 tmux 是唯一 Owner
goal_dimensions.risk_if_ignored: 并存路径会长期复制 Session 真相
goal_dimensions.next_probe: 确认后续 Feature 是原子替换还是永久多 Provider 架构
